serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: You: Here. Is this enough for a little of your time? #Landlord.Face.Grin #Landlord.Arms.Money Landlord: Oh~ You didn’t have to! You were always my favorite tenant, you know? Landlord: So. With what do you need my help? If it’s something not completely legal, I might require some additional funds, if you know what I mean~ You: It’s nothing like that. I need a model for a fashion show. #Landlord.Arms.Normal Landlord: Well, I can’t say that I’m surprised, really. I always had my way with the ladies. Landlord: Maybe my physique isn’t like it used to, but you would be surprised how many women appreciate a little bigger build. That’s disgusting… You: We need to go now if we wanna make it in time. Let’s go! Landlord: If you want me to run you will have to pay me extra. I hate getting sweaty.
